At Highway 90, we believe cannabis should be more than a product—it should be an experience. That’s why we’ve built more than just a dispensary. We’ve created a destination where every visit feels personal, welcoming, and inspiring. Located in the heart of Marlton, NJ, just minutes from Cherry Hill and a short drive from Philadelphia, Highway 90 is proud to be the go-to cannabis dispensary near you for locals and visitors alike.

Whether you’re a seasoned consumer or exploring cannabis for the first time, Highway 90 is your trusted partner in the journey. As a recreational dispensary, we welcome adults 21+ to come in, ask questions, and explore a curated selection of premium cannabis products designed to fit your lifestyle and elevate your experience.

Why We’re Different

Highway 90 isn’t your average NJ dispensary. We’ve cultivated a vibe that reflects our values: quality, community, and accessibility. From the moment you walk through our doors, our knowledgeable and friendly staff are here to make sure you feel at ease. We take pride in our hand-picked selection of top-shelf flower, potent concentrates, mouth-watering edibles, soothing topicals, cannabis accessories, and innovative vape and pre-roll options—all carefully sourced from the most respected cultivators and brands in New Jersey.

We’re constantly updating our menu to bring you the best the Garden State has to offer. Looking for something specific? Our budtenders are always happy to guide you based on your needs, preferences, or curiosity. Whether you’re searching for weed near me, a “dispensary near me open now,” or just want to explore what a high-quality cannabis experience can be, Highway 90 is here for you.

A Convenient Stop on Your Cannabis Journey

Looking for a weed store near you with easy access and great vibes? Highway 90 is conveniently located right off major highways in Marlton, NJ, making us a perfect stop for residents and travelers alike. If you’re coming from Cherry Hill, Voorhees, or Philadelphia, our location offers the perfect blend of convenience and premium service. When people search “cannabis dispensary near me” or “New Jersey dispensary with the best selection,” they find Highway 90—and for good reason.

Committed to Community and Cannabis Education

We’re more than a dispensary—we’re educators, advocates, and neighbors. At Highway 90, we’re passionate about destigmatizing cannabis, supporting responsible consumption, and helping customers make informed decisions. Whether you’re seeking relief, sleep, relaxation, or just a good time, our staff is here to guide you every step of the way. Our space is designed to be inviting and accessible, so every customer feels welcome. We’re committed to creating an environment where people can learn, explore, and celebrate cannabis culture in a safe and inclusive space.

Your Go-To NJ Dispensary

When you’re searching for a “recreational dispensary near me” or the most trusted NJ dispensary, look no further than Highway 90. We’re proud to serve the Marlton community and beyond with unmatched service, carefully selected products, and a passion for cannabis culture. Our returning customers love us because we listen, care, and deliver consistently excellent experiences. Stop by and experience the difference at Highway 90. Whether you’re a curious newcomer or a daily toker, we’ve got something special waiting for you. Come discover why Highway 90 is Marlton’s favorite cannabis dispensary.
